    StartersSeoul street chickenDouble-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and garlic glazeHow to make it1kg chicken wings1 L vegetable oil for frying3 tbsp gochujang3 tbsp honey4 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp sesame seedsPat the wings very dry.Fry in the vegetable oil at 160°C in batches until cooked, then rest on a rack.Fry again at 190°C until crackly and golden.Warm the gochujang with the honey, garlic and soy until glossy.Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.Sokovia pierogiCheddar potato dumplings boiled then fried with onions, served with sour creamHow to make it600g potatoes150g cheddar, grated30 dumpling wrappers2 brown onions, sliced60g butter150ml sour creamBoil the potatoes until tender, then mash with the cheddar and cool.Fill the wrappers with the potato mixture and pinch closed.Boil in batches until they float, then drain.Fry in butter with the onion until golden on both sides.Serve with sour cream.Avengers Tower beef carpaccio crostiniThe hammer party, where everyone is told they're not worthyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp garlic crostini topped with paper-thin seared beef, rocket, shaved parmesan, capers and a drizzle of lemon olive oil.Season a 400g eye fillet, sear hard on all sides for 3 minutes, then wrap tightly in cling film and freeze for 1 hour.Slice a baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with olive oil and bake at 180°C for 10 minutes, then rub with garlic.Slice the beef wafer thin.Top each crostini with rocket and beef, then shaved parmesan from 60g, a few capers, lemon juice and olive oil.MainsFarmhouse roast chicken and vegetablesRoast chicken, potatoes and carrots at the Barton farm, where the team hidesHow to make it2 whole chickens2 lemons6 thyme sprigs3 tbsp olive oil2 tsp salt1.5kg potatoes, cut into chunks6 carrots, cut into chunks500ml chicken stock2 tbsp plain flourRub the chickens with lemon, thyme, oil and salt and set in a large roasting tray with the potatoes and carrots.Roast at 200°C until the chicken is golden and cooked through and the vegetables are tender.Rest the chickens on a board.Make gravy in the tray with the flour, juices and stock.Carve and serve at a big farmhouse table.Johannesburg boerewors with pap and relishHulk versus the Hulkbuster in JohannesburgHow to make itAs written, serves 4Coriander-spiced beef sausage coils grilled over coals, with buttery maize meal pap and a warm tomato and onion relish.Grill 1kg thick beef sausages over medium coals for 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.For the relish, soften 2 sliced onions in oil, add 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp curry powder, 4 chopped tomatoes and 1 tbsp sugar, and simmer 15 minutes.Bring 1L salted water to the boil, whisk in 250g fine polenta and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes, then beat in 40g butter.SweetsFloating city pavlovaMeringue, cream and berries, a floating Sokovia you can eatHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar300ml thickened cream250g strawberries125g blueberriesWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy.Shape into a round on a lined tray.Bake at 120°C, then switch the oven off and cool the meringue inside.Whip the cream, spread over the meringue and top with the strawberries and blueberries.DrinksAsgardian honey mead punchMead with honey, cinnamon and clove syrup, lemon and ginger beer over iceHow to make it3 tbsp honey3 tbsp water1 cinnamon stick3 cloves500ml mead1 lemon500ml ginger beer1 orange, sliced1 bag iceWarm the honey with the water, cinnamon and cloves until the honey melts.Cool and strain the syrup.In a jug, mix the mead, honey syrup and lemon juice.Add plenty of ice, top with ginger beer and pour into glasses with orange slices.
